changes.summary: Count supported Anthropic caller input when hosted tools cannot be pre-counted, preserving full generation requests and exposing honest count scope
Allow SSE tool loops to reread changed files without silently completing; retain turn, time and token limits
Add reviewed per-model reasoning controls, provider translations, and compatible thinking stream replay.
Republish the capability catalog using npm packaging after the 0.2.2 registry artifact remained unavailable
Add browser-safe typed model capability metadata with verified provider sources, separate input and output modalities, context windows, and capability descriptions
Preserve provider output reservations and context-error recognition when routing models
Expose each tool-loop turn response metadata so consumers can price the actual served processing tier
Route exact model IDs to the same provider for token counting, capacity checks, preparation and generation
Exclude OpenAI cache-write tokens from ordinary input so cache-aware billing never charges the same tokens twice
Preserve every parallel OpenAI tool result and subsequent conversation turn without overwriting expanded messages
Allow a separate preparation model with its own verified capacity while preserving the final answer model and invalidating notes when the preparation model changes
Fill preparation sections with bounded tokenizer-checked refinement, avoid duplicate final counting, and honor cancellation before generation

Validate model capacity by default across generation, structured output, WebSocket and SSE entry points; reserve token headroom and support one protocol-preserving context recovery attempt. Providers without counting capability now fail explicitly; contextPolicy: false opts into raw behavior.
Add one-section text preparation steps for durable workers, with explicit pending/ready outcomes and checkpoint persistence before yielding
Budget final retrieval instructions and tools before compacting text, with matching checkpoint invalidation

Preserve conversation origin across long-text preparation sections, distinguish source facts from embedded instructions, reserve more of the available context for factual notes, and invalidate checkpoints from the previous preparation policy
Keep compacted text useful with read-only original-source search, checkpointed ingestion, and capacity-checked terminal tool loops
Regenerate the OpenRouter client declaration with equivalent reordered response union types
Add model-specific token capacity, optional provider capacity configuration, and recoverable long-text preparation
